answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the mirror queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The tundra index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1926 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the grove. Verification alone takes 5 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
